lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
A student scans a hand-drawn map. Name the input, the processing, the output and the storage for that job, using the scanner rather than the sports camera.

FEEDBACK
The scanner is the input because it takes in the drawing, and processing turns the scan into a picture file. Output is the map on the screen or on a printout, and storage is the saved picture file that can be opened later. Printing is another output, and it does not replace the stored file.

WATCH FOR
A common mistake is to think the screen stores the photo, so turning the screen off would delete the saved file.

Write a short reflection naming one observation, criterion or step you corrected and why.
